abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: After this fighter Moves or is relocated, you may swap it with target fighter in The Void. If it is unoccupied, you may instead relocate this fighter to The Void.

abilities.name: Shadow Underfoot
abilities.text: Relocate target Shadow you control underneath target friendly fighter.

abilities.name: Rip Seams
abilities.text: Relocate target adjacent friendly fighter to The Void, even on top of another fighter with the same owner.

abilities.name: Thrum Blade
abilities.text: If you have fewer cards in your hand than each opponent, this fighter has +II when Attacking and +I when being Attacked.

abilities.name: Temporal Shed
abilities.text: If this fighter is in your Gates at the start of your Action Phase, gain an additional action.

cards.name: Migration
cards.text: Choose a square in your Back Row. That square is now your Gates. (You may put your Stronghold behind it as a reminder.) If you still have cards in your deck, shuffle this card into your deck.

cards.name: Winds of the Steppe
cards.text: Choose a direction. Move all fighters that are not in any Gates 1 square in that direction. Enemy fighters that were Moved start their owners' next turn fatigued.

abilities.text: During your turn, this square is considered The Void, even if a fighter is on top of it.

cards.name: Avatar's Burden
cards.text: Attach to your Stronghold in play, regardless of position. While this fighter is in play, you have no Gates. (Other effects may still consider squares as your Gates.)

cards.name: Drop Shadow
cards.text: Put target Shadow into its owner's hand without its stack. Then, you may Deploy a Shadow.

abilities.name: Yoke of The Void
abilities.text: During your turn, squares adjacent to this fighter are considered adjacent to The Void.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.text: If this fighter is destroyed, you lose the game.
